name: What is the difference between hiring a landscape architect and a design-build firm for a backyard renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between hiring a landscape architect and a design-build firm for a backyard renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A landscape architect typically focuses solely on the design and planning aspects of your outdoor space, providing detailed blueprints and material specifications. You would then hire a separate contractor to execute the construction based on those plans. A design-build firm, like Opus Builders, offers a single point of contact responsible for both the design and the construction phases. This integrated approach often leads to better communication, streamlined project management, more accurate budgeting, and a more cohesive final product, as the design intent is carried through directly into construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: A landscape architect designs, while a design-build firm handles both design and construction, offering a streamlined, single-point-of-contact approach.
